description: Look up a domain's registration record — registrar, created/expiry dates, nameservers, EPP status codes, provider DNSSEC evidence, and public registrant organization independently of contact redaction. Uses IANA bootstrap to select the correct per-TLD RDAP server, returning one normalized shape regardless of TLD. When the TLD has no RDAP coverage, throws rdap_no_coverage. A missing registry object throws domain_not_found; whois_check_availability returns record status without an eligibility guarantee. include_registrar opts into one bounded registrar referral with separate contact detail; registry fields remain authoritative.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to look up (e.g., "example.com", "github.com"). Must be a valid FQDN — labels separated by dots, each label up to 63 chars.

include_registrar.description: Follow one guarded registrar RDAP referral for optional contact detail. Registry fields remain authoritative; failed detail is disclosed without discarding the registry record.

name: whois_lookup_domain

dnssec_signed.description: Provider delegationSigned value; null when absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rdap_invalid_domain_response`: The primary RDAP response is not a matching successful domain object. `rdap_no_coverage`: TLD has no RDAP server in the IANA bootstrap — cannot perform lookup. `domain_not_found`: RDAP server returned 404 — no domain record found. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

handle.description: Registry handle / object identifier assigned by the registry.

rdap_coverage.description: True when a RDAP server was found for this TLD; false when RDAP coverage is absent.

rdap_last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last RDAP database update.

registrant_org.description: Public registrant organization from jCard org. Omitted when absent or a placeholder; contact redaction is independent.

registrant_redacted.description: True for explicit registrant redaction evidence; null when privacy evidence is absent.

registrar_detail.description: Registrar contact detail only when include_registrar is true.

registrant_org.description: Public registrar-reported organization, independent of contact redaction.

registrant_redacted.description: Explicit registrar privacy evidence; null when absent.

source.description: Registrar RDAP source URL, or attempted referral on failure.

source_error.description: Optional detail failure; registry fields remain usable.

updated_date.description: ISO 8601 date of last registration record change.

title: Domain Registration Lookup
